messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: control-plane dependencies elevated 5xx rate detected (auth + org-lookup + config) — paging oncall
Priya: acked. I'm on it, pulling up dashboards now :eyes:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty: Incident p12345 assigned to Priya
Priya: quick snapshot: 3.2k rps to control-plane, overall 5xx -> 14% in the last 3m. Top 3 error sources: auth(502), org-lookup(504), config-service(5xx).
Priya: running a few quick queries in grafana /logs -> org-lookup shows repeated "timeout awaiting response" from org-db-proxy at ~10s
Ethan: I can run a top-level control-plane trace. Priya do we have a correlation id?
Priya: sample trace ids: trace=abcd1234, abcd1235. spans show auth->org-lookup RPCs blocking on db-proxy.conns.
Sanjay: I see connection queue length spike on auth instances. kernel stats show many TIME_WAIT but not obvious OOM. Could be connection saturation or upstream DB throttling.
Maya: Config service also spiking 5xx with "read deadline exceeded" in logs. Possibly same root cause (downstream db or network flapping).
Priya: customer impact: hosted API errors for token introspection and org-based routing. Some dedicated customers in us-west seeing 50% request failure to control-plane dependent endpoints. CS-L2, can you start capturing impacted customer list?
CS-L2: on it — pulling list from recent alerts, will DM exports.
Ethan: immediate mitigations proposal: 1) disable billing check calls for token validation path (feature-flag toggle) 2) route auth traffic to fallback auth-legacy pool that uses cached org lookups 3) raise org-lookup replicas + increase connection pool to DB proxy 4) add retry/backoff at gateway for config calls
Priya: agree. Prioritize 1 and 2 for fastest impact. Who has perms to flip feature flags?
Maya: I can flip feature-flag: enable-billing-checks=false in prod feature-store. Doing now.
Maya: done. propagation ~30s.
Priya: confirmed reduced tail on auth path for billing check calls. 5xx from billing-check endpoint dropped to near zero. overall 5xx now 9%
Sanjay: scaling org-lookup: kubectl scale deploy org-lookup --replicas=6 -n control-plane
Sanjay: executed. New pods coming up.
Ethan: increasing db-proxy connection pool: SSHing to proxy-manager to bump max_conns from 400 -> 800.
Ethan: config change applied.
Priya: adding traffic routing to fallback auth pool (auth-legacy) via routing rule: rbctl route set auth primary=fallback-legacy rate=20%
Priya: applied canary-like 20% to fallback.
oncall-bot: Deploy Bot: routing rule applied successfully.
Priya: initial metric: 20% routed to fallback shows 5xx for those requests < 1%. overall error rate dips to 6%
PagerBot: NOTE: Pager escalation threshold reached if 5xx > 10% for 10m. Current 5xx 6% (5m).
Ethan: good sign. Need to watch connection churn on db-proxy while new org-lookup replicas warm up.
Sanjay: logs from new org-lookup pods show GC pauses earlier but steady now. No errors.
Priya: config-service still has occasional 5xxs. Investigating whether it's dependent on org-lookup calls for per-org config fetches.
Maya: can we short-circuit config reads for requests that already have org cached? Add simple cache header bypass until stable. I'll push a hotfix: set ENABLE_CONFIG_CACHE=true for gateway-level caching.
Maya: hotfix pushed, cache warming.
Priya: metrics: config 5xx down to near 0. Overall 5xx 2.4% at 5m. Latency recovering.
Ethan: next steps: 1) keep routing fallback at 20% for 30 min, 2) monitor db-proxy connection metrics for 30m, 3) prepare rollback plan for feature flags.
Priya: I will stay on for next 35m, then hand off to Ethan for night shift. Ethan you good to take over?
Ethan: I'm taking over at +35m. Please add notes to the incident channel and update PagerDuty with "mitigation in place, monitoring"
Priya: done: PD note updated. Summary: billing checks disabled, auth fallback canary at 20%, org-lookup scaled, db-proxy pool increased, gateway cache enabled. Customer impact reduced from 14% to 2.4% 5xx.
CS-L2: exported impacted-customer list to #incidents-drops and emailed account owners for top 5 customers.
Sanjay: filed a ticket to investigate root cause: likely DB-proxy connection leak under spike. Ticket tkt-4593 created and assigned to infra-db.
Priya: recording temp mitigations for postmortem: - billing-checks FF off - auth fallback routing 20% - org-lookup scaled to 6 - db-proxy max_conns bumped - gateway cache enabled
Priya: I'll open the incident postmortem doc and add timeline. Who can help fill traces?
Ethan: I'll collect traces and flamegraphs. Sanjay you + infra-db should look at proxy connection metrics and kernel/network counters.
Priya: thanks all. Handing off to Ethan at 1924007310. leaving thread for async updates. :white_check_mark:
